snapshot.title: Show real telescope image of mission target during space transit
snapshot.description: During the 20-second TRAVEL phase of rocket_transit, show the actual telescope image of the mission target fetched from the starsailors.space API. This is THE citizen science engagement moment — users see real astronomical data related to their target before mining. Works for predefined targets (M1/M2) using known asteroid IDs and for scanner targets (M3+) using the selected anomaly ID stored in RocketsManager preview target.

acceptanceCriteria.text: During TRAVEL phase, a panel fades in showing 'Incoming telescope data' then the target image
Uses same API pattern as SimpleDetailView (starsailors.space storage endpoint)
Shows target name, data source (e.g. 'NASA TESS dataset' or 'Active Asteroids')
Graceful fallback if image fails to load (show target name + placeholder text)
Panel is dismissible / auto-hides when travel phase ends
